claims.assertion: Mari Swa portrays the Galactic Federation as a tiered council system where species can reach only local representatives; she says Earth-level officials claim higher authorities near Saturn issue orders but cannot be contacted.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: These are her allegations about the Federation's structure and Earth situation.

claims.assertion: Mari Swa recounts that a high-ranking Andromedan Federation representative urged her to stop criticizing the Federation and organizing counter-meetings; she says she rejected Federation direction over Taygetan policy.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as her account of a conversation on August 13, 2024.

review_flags: The source opens by framing its content as entertainment and presents disputed geopolitical allegations as first-person testimony.
coverage_gaps: The video also alleges Federation propaganda, exclusion zones near Solar System planets, and an attempted attack on Queen Alenym.
